notes.content:

For the next 2 weeks, Moonlit Reaper will be on special discount.

This is the perfect moment for new Reapers to step into the fight.

Another seasonal sale is on the horizon, though with smaller discounts than now.

notes.title: 🌕 Live: Karmic Exchange, Achievements, and Discount Notice
notes.content:
✨ Where We Are, and What Comes Next


Step by step, the key parts of Moonlit Reaper are falling into place, and we are finally ready to welcome more Reapers into the world. In about a week, the in game store will be refreshed and a discount will be available.

At this point, nearly all of the core features are implemented. From here, our focus will shift toward expanding the stages and completing the story in preparation for full release. We are happy to share that the timeline for launch is still on track as originally promised.


[hr][/hr]

♻️ Karmic Exchange Opens
Earn Karmic Tokens when turning back time through Transcendence, especially after clearing stages perfectly

Use tokens to purchase skill points, permanent barriers, relics, various resets, and more

More exciting content will be added in future updates



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/a05c0c23a06d888746a70aea920ea3fe32f13b52.png"]

Developer’s Note: We understand that stepping back through Transcendence can feel like leaving precious progress behind. The Karmic Exchange is our way of honoring those efforts, turning what is lost into a gift that helps you grow even stronger.


[hr][/hr]

🏆 Achievements Arrive
New achievement system added, each carrying a name with its own charm.

Achievements grant stat bonuses and rewards to strengthen your journey



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/a9dd79be6bd953d19b384526f233b43ea9789f2d.png"]
[hr][/hr]

⚙️ Other Changes


Added new tutorial guidance

Added Restock feature to the store

Store expansion upgrade removed; now always at maximum capacity

Store expansion upgrade replaced with Restock availability upgrade

Adjusted appearance distribution of store stock

Revised text for better thematic consistency

Removed non offensive weapons such as support and passive types for simplicity

Reworked weapon progression, adding tiers so each weapon type can scale with player progression

Removed Soul Energy system for simplicity; skills now use Mana

Clara Core system expanded, allowing up to 100 simultaneous cores with decreasing cost

Difficulty and balance adjustments, as always

UI/UX improvements, as always

Knockback tweaks: monsters without knockback stay fixed, while bosses continue to resist

These adjustments are part of our ongoing effort to keep the experience clear, balanced, and true to the spirit of Moonlit Reaper.

notes.title: 💫 Incoming: Update and Future Discount
notes.content:
🛠️ Update


Our next step is an update focused on finalizing features and polishing the game, including new achievements and completed themes. This phase will tie together everything we’ve been building so far, making Moonlit Reaper feel more complete and ready for what’s to come.


[hr][/hr]

🏷️ Future Discount


After the update goes live, we’ll take some time to see how things unfold before launching a special discount. We’ll announce the discount one week in advance so you’ll have plenty of time to get ready. Keep your eyes open — when the moment arrives, it will be the perfect chance to step into the world and experience the harvest at its best.

notes.title: 🌑 Incoming: New Map System, World Purity, and Post-Battle Summary
notes.content:
This update adds strategic freedom and clearer feedback to every fight.
Major changes reshape how you progress through the world, how you see its response, and how each step leaves something behind.

[hr][/hr]
🗺️ The Map Unfolds – A World of Choices
The world now unfolds as a map with three distinct realms.
Choose your next stage freely and carve your own path.
 See what lies ahead — Preview each stage’s enemies and rewards, and plan your next move.
 Plan your journey — will you pursue a rare reward, or press forward toward the unknown?
 Shape your experience — every realm offers a different rhythm, threat, and tone
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/be2fba05605de170b15beb052f658b9efbe9f724.png
Developer Comment:
"The world doesn’t push you forward anymore. It waits for you to choose your own way."
[hr][/hr]
🌒 World Purity – What You Leave Behind Will Find You
Enemies that escape don't disappear — they spread darkness across the world.
Each one you miss lowers World Purity and strengthens what comes next.
 The lower the purity, the stronger future enemies become, infecting the next stages you enter
 At 0% Purity, the world succumbs to ruin — and the game ends
 Through Transcendence, the world’s purity can be restored to an earlier state
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/38136245ddf908eadfcba0468797ed43e61b3e00.pngDeveloper Comment:
"You cannot purify what you ignore. But you may yet undo what you regret."
[hr][/hr]
🌓 A Clearer View – Battle and Transcendence Results

Each battle now ends with a summary screen showing Soul gained and enemies escaped.
You’ll also see how their escape affected World Purity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/1e4448ce3c0333ee6ce610324b55db8f588e5c01.png

Transcendence now shows when you returned, how many skill points you gained, and what changed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/20bb8bc98c50f5855b43a55063eb0de8d1d734b4.png
Developer Comment:
"A journey means more when you can finally see the path you've taken."

notes.title: 🌑 Update Live: Rebalance and Expansion
notes.content:
The previously announced update is now live, delivering core system enhancements, stage expansion, and exciting new challenges.

✨ Key Features

 Zodiac System Introduced
Replacing the former Training System, the Zodiac now grants stat bonuses based on your level.
 Stage Expansion
The number of stages has been increased to 30, offering extended progression and more diverse encounters.
 Two New Bosses Added
Prepare for new threats as two powerful bosses now await beyond the threshold.
 Combat System Improvements
Weapon cooldowns and delays between switches have been removed to support fast-paced multi-weapon combat.
Enjoy seamless chaining of attacks and more dynamic gameplay with your full arsenal.
 Transcendence Adjustments
Upon Transcendence, your level is now preserved, and skill points are granted immediately for smoother restarts.
⚖️ Gameplay Rebalance and Difficulty Tweaks

 Monster strength curve adjusted: HP and spawn patterns rebalanced for smoother progression.
 Reduced mana costs on most weapons to allow more frequent weapon usage.
 Item drop rate increased to support easier early-game progression.
 Soul Energy cost slightly increases as skills are upgraded, encouraging more strategic use.
 Soul Energy income slightly reduced in higher stages.
 The number of initial weapon slots has been increased from one to two.
 Transcendence is now unlocked upon first defeat or after clearing the first boss.

🆕 New Weapons Released
Two new weapons have joined the fight, offering fresh ways to control the battlefield.
They’re now available — and there’s no better time to jump in and try them for yourself.
Frost Piercer
Unleashes a piercing roar of frost in a straight line, striking up to 8 times.
Especially effective against enemies charging along the horizontal axis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/2bce46ac4500261298aa7cb6e844eff5f1a070cb.gif
Void Vortex
Summons a vortex that deals damage over time and pulls enemies inward.
A powerful tool for controlling groups within its range.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/0e5a6a552d9e24180b9635b238ad77750e1b0197.gif

🗡️ Choose Your Starting Weapon
You can now choose your starting weapon set based on difficulty.
Each option reflects the difficulty you select.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/993d6d11889f675377cb2e7373d677a24720553f.png Three options are available, visually labeled as Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert.
 Choosing Sword or Scythe grants two starting weapons.
 Choosing Staff provides a single, high-impact ranged weapon.

🛠️ UI and UX Improvements

 Added additional sound effects for improved responsiveness.
 Supplemented missing translations across various interfaces.
 Softened visual effects in shop interfaces where conversations are active.
 Differentiated upgrade icons that previously shared the same appearance.
 Stage selection now opens with the most recently unlocked stage in view.
 Reduced overly intense visuals on certain weapon attack effects.

🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where some eligible weapons would disappear during Transcendence.
 Resolved a bug that allowed multiple Transcendence triggers from rapid clicks.
 Corrected a case where Soul Shard values could become negative during scouting.

notes.title: Update: Difficulty Rebalanced, Stage 30 Expansion
notes.content:
Moonlit Reaper was always meant to be fun — for everyone.
But over time, we’ve come to understand where the challenge felt sharp — and where it simply felt punishing.

This upcoming update, arriving next week, smooths out the difficulty curve, rewires core systems, and opens the door to deeper battles beyond stage 20.

Whether you're just getting started or reaching for the farthest gate, things are about to feel a lot better — and a lot more dangerous.

1. Choose Your Stars: The New Zodiac System
The old Training system is gone.
In its place, the Zodiac System brings clarity, strategy, and long-term growth.

At each Transcendence, you now choose a constellation — and with it, a unique stat path that applies as you level up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/3b3583581ff088baf906b45c78d7dcea387024a5.png
No more random rolls.
No more hoping for the right stat.
Now, you shape your build from the start.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/6024075dc60fa589735705033804123f219ba8e3.png

Want raw power?
Choose the Taurus and gain Attack +1 every level.
Looking for something more brutal? The Scorpio rewards those who walk the hardest path.

Devoloper Comment: “Skill points were always precious — but the old Training system made it frustrating to use them well.
Random results often meant players couldn’t build the character they wanted.
With the new Zodiac system, every level feels like progress, not a gamble.”

2. Faster, Sharper, Deadlier: Combat Has Changed
Moonlit Reaper has always encouraged multi-weapon combat — but until now, it didn’t feel all that different from just using one.

That changes here.

 Harvester switch intervals have been slashed
 Harvester skill cooldowns are gone
 Combos now follow your full weapon set 
You’ll move faster, hit harder, and feel the difference between every build.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/12f41cbfdc4913e6319b86dcd7b4571145d2e28b.gif

And this is just the beginning —
future updates will continue to expand the thrill of multi-weapon combat.

Devoloper Comment: “We wanted multi-weapon combat to feel like a rhythm — not a routine.
Before, you could carry many weapons and still fight like you had one.
Now, every strike, every shift, every weapon — it all flows together.”

3. No More Reset: Transcendence, Refined
Previously, Transcendence returned you to level 1, slowing your early progress even as permanent upgrades carried forward.

That’s now changed.

With this update, your current level is preserved after Transcendence.
You’ll also instantly receive skill points equal to the number of levels you earned.

This allows for faster rebuilding, more meaningful early decisions, and a smoother transition into your next run.

Devoloper Comment: “Transcendence shouldn’t feel like rebuilding from zero.
Now, your momentum continues — and your choices start making a difference from the very first battle.”

4. Sharper Curve, Softer Edges
Moonlit Reaper was never meant to be punishing — but over time, it became clear that the early game felt harsher than intended.

This update revisits the balance across all stages.

 Enemy health values have been adjusted
 Spawn patterns beyond stage 15 have been refined

The goal is to preserve the thrill of challenge,
while ensuring that every player — from first-timers to seasoned Reapers — can enjoy the full journey.

Devoloper Comment: “We designed Moonlit Reaper to be challenging, not discouraging.
This rebalance keeps the danger — but lets more players reach the point where the game truly opens up.”

5. Into the Deep: Stage 30 and the Two That Wait
The game now extends to stage 30, opening new ground —
and with it, two figures that cast long shadows across the game.

You’ll face more than just stronger enemies.
You’ll face emotions turned into monsters.

One drains what makes you smile.
The other crushes what's left of your breath.

Hyperpressia — Stage 25 Boss
A hollow echo of joy — she drains happiness with stacking debuffs that wear you down.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/950b505d8222d83c600fcbf5ec1bef6acd8bcad8.png

Suppression Force — Stage 30 Boss
A silent oppressor — it overwhelms with relentless summons and heavy phase pressure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/d0c6db5378529e348b0ed07235be6a55c257fb53.png
They don’t break you. They make you realize you’re already broken.

Devoloper Comment: “We didn’t just raise the stakes.
We designed fights that make you think, adapt — and enjoy the chaos.
Every boss should challenge your build, your reflexes, and your fun.”

What’s Next
This isn’t the end of the journey — just a deeper step forward.

Next time, we’ll take you up to stage 35,
where new enemies and evolving threats will test every harvester you’ve mastered.

We’re also working on improvements to the combat system —
to make every run feel sharper, more dynamic, and more fun to play.

Thank you for playing Moonlit Reaper.

Your feedback, your battles, your persistence — they shape every step we take.
See you in the next update.

— Avocado Factory —

notes.title: 🌍 Language Update: Russian & Japanese Support
notes.content:
Russian and Japanese language support has been added.
Some translations may be improved in future updates.
Thanks for your patience — more to come soon!

notes.title: One Week Since Launch — And a Quick Language Update!
notes.content:
🪔 One Week Together
It’s been one week since Moonlit Reaper first opened its gates.
We’re grateful to everyone who has joined us on this journey — truly, thank you.

We also want to give a special thanks to players from Russia and Japan —
many of you played the game even without native language support, and that truly moved us.

As a small gesture of appreciation, we’ve added Russian and Japanese language support — available this week!
This update focuses solely on localization, and we’re still refining certain terms — so feel free to share your feedback anytime.

🗣️ We’re also preparing additional support for Korean and Traditional Chinese (for players in Hong Kong and beyond).
These will be included in a future update — and we’re working to make it worth the wait.

✨ Did you know?
Spring is the perfect season for a picnic in the Dogaby village...
just watch out for the ones that don’t come for the food.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/1bd20490613fdbb881dcd35d2d3ccc5f138c2bcd.png
If you haven't yet, try clearing the Picnic Quest — it rewards you with a beginner-friendly relic that could tip the balance in early battles.

✅ What’s next?

 Stage Expansion:  Soon, the world will grow to include 30 stages filled with new threats.
 More Surprises:  balance tweaks, secrets, and new harvesters and relics are on the way.

Thank you again for being with us during this early chapter.
We’ll keep improving Moonlit Reaper step by step — with your help.

Stay steady, and keep your Harvester sharp.

notes.title: 🌙 Moonlit Reaper is now available in Early Access
notes.content:
🌑 When the night grows deep and the world looks away, a Dogaby rises.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/08c4e3c0944173a025e85fb0882b4658504a2840.png
Today, we're proud to officially launch Moonlit Reaper, a stage-based roguelite action RPG that blends intense hack and slash combat, strategic base defense, and emotional storytelling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/ffa2bd031f168db2b5b3a19d324751b85b64007c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/17b3849171a110d2ed5bdf7b19e32d819fb6c276.png
Take up your Harvester and step into a world where every fall is a lesson, and every harvest brings you closer to the truth. Fight back waves of wicked creatures, seal the darkness within the battlefield, and shape your own legacy through each trial.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/9aad178422c80ac572b22a169584557c9fa388f4.png

From the quiet village that remembers the stars, to the shadowed lands scarred by the Crimson Eclipse, your story as a young Dogaby begins now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577492/2db65f6c13e0276770625eeb3030de45d3a690af.png

This is more than a launch.
It’s the beginning of a shared journey between us.

🌑 What to Expect

⚔️ Stage-based roguelite action RPG with fast-paced hack and slash combat

🛡️ Strategic base defense where every decision matters

🔁 Roguelite progression with permanent upgrades and transcendence

🐉 Unique bosses and monsters beyond redemption

🏡 A village to return to — upgrade, forge, and prepare

💠 Soul harvesting with resource management and strategy

🧍‍♂️ Emotional storytelling with quiet moments and heartfelt choices

🌀 Random encounters through action point–based exploration

🛠️ New stages and content will be added regularly throughout Early Access
